article.title: Why Retries Can Turn a Small Failure into Duplicate Data
article.why: Understand why retry safety depends on idempotent writes.

paragraphs.en:
Retries are one of the simplest ways to make a data system more resilient. A network request times out, a worker crashes, or a database connection briefly disappears, so the system tries the operation again. This is often exactly the right behavior. But a retry is safe only when repeating the operation does not create an unwanted second effect.

Imagine a pipeline that receives a batch of 10,000 transactions and inserts them into a table. The insert succeeds, but the acknowledgement from the database is lost because of a network problem. The pipeline believes the write failed and retries the same batch. If the table accepts the rows again, the final dataset contains 20,000 records even though only 10,000 real transactions occurred.

The same pattern can be more serious outside analytics. A retry might send the same customer message twice, charge an account twice, create two support tickets, or trigger the same downstream workflow more than once. The original technical failure may have lasted only seconds, but the duplicated side effect can require hours of investigation and repair.

This is why reliable systems aim for idempotent operations. An idempotent operation can be repeated with the same logical request without changing the final state after the first successful application. In a data pipeline, one common technique is to assign a stable unique key to each record and use an upsert or merge instead of a blind append. Another is to write a batch to a staging area and atomically replace the target partition only after validation succeeds.

Request identifiers can protect APIs and event-driven systems. The client sends an idempotency key with the request; if the server sees the same key again, it returns the previous result instead of executing the business action a second time. For message consumers, storing processed event IDs can prevent duplicate delivery from becoming duplicate processing.

Exactly-once behavior is difficult across distributed systems, so practical designs often assume that messages may arrive more than once and make consumers tolerant of duplicates. This changes the engineering question from ‘How do we guarantee that a retry never happens?’ to ‘How do we guarantee that a retry does not corrupt business state?’

Monitoring should also look for duplication. Compare unique business keys with row counts, track repeated event IDs, and alert when a batch is processed unusually often. During incident review, distinguish between duplicate delivery and duplicate effect: receiving an event twice may be acceptable if the second processing attempt changes nothing.

Retries are therefore not merely an error-handling feature. They are part of the data-consistency design. A resilient pipeline needs both the willingness to try again and the discipline to make trying again safe.
paragraphs.zh:
Retry 是提升資料系統韌性最簡單的方法之一。Network request timeout、worker crash 或 database connection 短暫中斷時，系統重新執行操作通常是正確行為。但 retry 只有在重複操作不會造成第二次不必要副作用時才安全。

假設 pipeline 收到10,000筆交易並 insert 到 table。Insert 實際成功，但因網路問題，database acknowledgement 遺失。Pipeline 誤以為寫入失敗，於是重跑同一批資料。如果 table 再次接受這些 rows，最後會有20,000筆紀錄，儘管真實交易只有10,000筆。

在 analytics 之外後果可能更嚴重。Retry 可能重複寄送顧客訊息、重複扣款、建立兩張 support ticket，或重複觸發 downstream workflow。原始技術故障也許只有幾秒，但 duplicate side effect 可能需要數小時調查與修復。

因此可靠系統會追求 idempotent operations。Idempotent operation 在同一 logical request 被重複執行時，第一次成功後最終狀態不再改變。Data pipeline 常見做法是給每筆資料 stable unique key，使用 upsert 或 merge，而不是 blind append；也可以先寫 staging area，驗證成功後再 atomic replace target partition。

Request identifier 可以保護 API 與 event-driven system。Client 在 request 中附 idempotency key；server 再次看到相同 key 時，回傳前一次結果，而不是再執行一次 business action。Message consumer 也可保存 processed event IDs，避免 duplicate delivery 變成 duplicate processing。

Distributed system 中真正 exactly-once 很難，因此實務設計常假設 message 可能重複到達，並讓 consumer 對 duplicate 有容忍力。工程問題從「如何保證 retry 永遠不發生」轉成「如何保證 retry 不破壞 business state」。

Monitoring 也應檢查 duplication，例如比較 unique business keys 與 row counts、追蹤重複 event IDs、對異常多次 batch processing 告警。Incident review 時要區分 duplicate delivery 與 duplicate effect：收到同一 event 兩次未必有問題，只要第二次 processing 不改變狀態。

因此 retry 不只是 error handling feature，而是 data-consistency design 的一部分。真正 resilient 的 pipeline 既要願意重試，也要讓重試本身是安全的。
paragraphs.ja:
retryはデータシステムのresilienceを高める最も単純な方法の一つです。network requestのtimeout、worker crash、database connectionの一時切断が起きたとき、operationを再実行するのは多くの場合正しい対応です。ただし、同じoperationを繰り返して不要な二重効果が発生しない場合に限ってretryは安全です。

10,000件のtransaction batchをtableへinsertするpipelineを考えます。insert自体は成功したものの、network問題でdatabaseからのacknowledgementが失われたとします。pipelineはwrite failureだと判断し同じbatchをretryします。tableが再度rowsを受け入れれば、実取引は10,000件なのに20,000recordsになります。

analytics以外ではさらに深刻です。同じcustomer messageを2回送り、accountを二重請求し、support ticketを2件作り、同じdownstream workflowを複数回起動する可能性があります。元の技術障害は数秒でもduplicate side effectの調査・修復には何時間もかかるかもしれません。

そのため信頼できるsystemはidempotent operationを目指します。同じlogical requestを繰り返しても最初の成功後にfinal stateが変わらないoperationです。data pipelineではstable unique keyを付け、blind appendではなくupsertやmergeを使う方法があります。staging areaへ書き、validation成功後にtarget partitionをatomicに置換する設計もあります。

APIやevent-driven systemではrequest identifierが役立ちます。clientがidempotency keyを送り、serverが同じkeyを再度受け取ったらbusiness actionを再実行せず前回結果を返します。message consumerではprocessed event IDを保存し、duplicate deliveryがduplicate processingにならないようにできます。

distributed systemで完全なexactly-onceを実現するのは難しいため、実務ではmessageが複数回来る前提でconsumerをduplicate tolerantにすることが多いです。問いは「retryを絶対に起こさない」から「retryしてもbusiness stateを壊さない」へ変わります。

monitoringでもduplicationを確認します。unique business keyとrow countを比較し、重複event IDを追跡し、batchが異常回数処理されたらalertします。incident reviewではduplicate deliveryとduplicate effectを区別します。同じeventを2回受け取っても、2回目が状態を変えなければ許容できる場合があります。

つまりretryは単なるerror-handling featureではなくdata-consistency designの一部です。resilient pipelineには再試行する仕組みと、再試行しても安全である設計の両方が必要です。
